description: Filtering the file list to a term with no matches shows only the column headers and a footer that still says '9 loaded'.
expected: A 'No files match "zzz-nothing"' row with a Clear filter control.
actual: Empty table body; footer '9 loaded'; column widths shift.
suggested_fix: Render an empty-state row when the filtered list is empty; keep column widths fixed.

description: Trash uses a native window.confirm ('Move /tests/sample.bin to trash?') and shows no notice afterwards, while Restore asks nothing and shows a styled success banner.
expected: Trash is reversible, so no confirm; show a notice like 'Moved to Trash · Undo'.
actual: Native browser confirm, then the row silently disappears.
suggested_fix: Drop the confirm for Trash (it is recoverable) and show the same success banner Restore uses.
